$comment: Return contract for the code-auditor-score workflow (.claude/workflows/code-auditor-score.js). The workflow's final return must be exactly this object and nothing else — narration goes to log(). Consumed by code-auditor SKILL.md's invoke -> validate -> fall-back seam. ABORT CONTRACT: a fully aborted run (2+ dead scorers) returns null for composite/band/recommendation; those nulls intentionally FAIL this schema (composite is 'number', not ['number','null']; the enums do not admit null) so the caller's prose fallback takes over instead of trusting a confident wrong score. Only individual components entries may be null — that is the single-dead-scorer degraded path, which still yields a valid renormalized composite with degraded=true.

composite.$comment: Weighted 0-100 composite over the surviving scorer components (weights 0.40/0.35/0.25, renormalized when one scorer is dead). Non-null by design: an aborted run's null must fail validation.

band.$comment: Routing band over the composite: Low 0-39, Medium 40-69, High 70-100.

recommendation.$comment: Reviewer routing: 'scout' (light review, also the trivial-diff fast path), 'ranger' (deep review, High band or autonomous-mode borderline 65-74 escalation), 'none' (documentation-only change).

components.$comment: Per-scorer clamped 0-100 scores. A null entry means that scorer died or returned a schema-invalid result; with exactly one null the composite is renormalized over the survivors and degraded is true.

degraded.$comment: True when at least one scorer component is unavailable and the composite was renormalized over the survivors.
